verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a changelog note that incident.io is improving its first-party Terraform provider 'resource by resource' for infra-as-code. That would let config be versioned, reviewed and rolled back through a git workflow, but the evidence never confirms Workflows/automations are covered. Separately, Workflows exist as automations (status-page auto-publishing), but nothing shows native version history, review/approval, or rollback for them. Missing for 10: confirmation that Workflows are manageable via Terraform/config-as-code, native automation version history, change review/approval flow, one-click rollback, independent corroboration.
